venues.editor_note: On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Friday fry described as shrimp and perch. Neighborhood bar with banquet hall, pool, darts, patio. Listed hours are bar hours - confirm the fry window.

Own website publishes the full fish fry. Serving since 1926. Haddock baked or fried 2pc $9.50 / 3pc $11.50, 7pc shrimp $13.50, walleye $18. Coleslaw, bread, fries or potato salad. Dine-in or takeout. Attached ballroom - good sponsor story.

Home-style cafe. Tue-Sat 6:30AM-2PM but Friday extends to 7PM - the Friday-only evening hours corroborate the fry. Reviews cite crispy fish, homemade bread, coleslaw, tartar. No phone from a reliable source.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Haddock fry with fries, twice-baked potato or wedges, coleslaw and dinner roll, from their own site. Downtown Merrill with real web presence - likely paid-tier prospect. Already in WPR's Lenten guide.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark (entirely)). Panko-breaded cod with twice-baked potato and seafood bisque; fish Fridays, prime rib Saturdays. One aggregator calls it among the best Friday frys in the Wausau area. Listed hours are bar hours.

Stratford mailing address but physically in Rozellville (Town of Day). Building dates to the 1800s as a blacksmith/buggy shop - the fireplace was the forge, horses tied at what is now the back bar. Reservations advised Fridays. Great story for a featured slot.
4th in the 2026 reader poll.
Runner-up, 2026 reader poll. Haddock comes baked or fried.
Rural bar & grill on County Rd N outside Marathon City, listed with a popular Friday fish fry. Also on DoorDash as 'Charlie's Bar and Grill'. Species and price unknown.
Tied 6th in the 2026 reader poll.
Recently operating as Prost Hill Bar & Grill.
Bowling center with full bar & grill; Friday Fish Fry listed. On the Wausau Friday Fish Fry Guide with matching address/phone. Closed Sun/Mon. Species and price not published.
Six-digit address is Marathon County rural numbering with an Aniwa mailing address - worth confirming. Reviews specifically praise the Friday-night fish fry. Species not sourced.

venues.venue_name: Country Aire Restaurant, Bar & Banquet Hall
venues.editor_note: Own menu: 'famous plated cod Fish fry', 2pc or 3pc dinner with coleslaw, rye bread, choice of potato. Available until 9PM in the bar; soup and salad bar add-on. Prices not published.

60-lane bowling center; in-house Northwoods Bar & Grill runs 'Fish Fry Fridays'. Owner is a Marathon County Tavern League board member. Species/price not published (seasonal PDF menus only). Strong sponsor prospect.
Recently operating as Chacks Day Break Bar & Grill.
Bar near the Big Eau Pleine Flowage, south Marathon County. Perch and walleye called out; deep-fried walleye and grilled shrimp are listed favorites. Confirm whether cod is on the Friday board.
OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Friday fry 3PM-8PM confirmed from the venue's own Facebook post. Also praised for fried chicken. Species not named. Rural address at the Hwy 64/107 junction.
Family restaurant with on-site truck stop off Hwy 29. 'Fish Fry Friday' as a daily special; clam chowder is the Friday soup. Confirm species and price.

Also EML / EML Rozellville - physically in Rozellville, Town of Day, Marathon County, Stratford mailing address. TIED FOR BEST FISH FRY IN MARATHON COUNTY in a WAOW viewers' poll (with Cassel Bar & Grill, already in the guide). Fish fry with choice of potato incl. potato pancakes, slaw, roll; 1pc $8, 2pc $9 (older pricing). ADDRESS CONFLICT: WAOW/Visit Marshfield give 206423 Hwy M, Yelp gives D3292 County Road M - verify.
OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). NOT the same as the Wausau Eagle's Club already in the guide - this is Merrill Aerie #584. Open to the public; dinner Tue and Fri from 4PM.
OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark (entirely)). Country bar & grill, homemade pizza and Friday fish frys per the AbbyColby Chamber listing. Species not named. Rural fire-number address.
Homemade fish fry.
Countryside tavern in the Town of Green Valley (south Marathon County), Mosinee mailing address. Cod, walleye, perch, jumbo gulf shrimp Fridays. Also known for broasted chicken. Closed Mon-Tue.
9th in the 2026 reader poll.
10th in the 2026 reader poll.

Opened Jan 2021 in the former BS's Bar & Grill building - do not list BS's separately. 'HOME'made beer batter fish Fridays (likely cod). PHONE CONFLICT: Village directory 715-352-8199, a Facebook post 715-443-0221, Tavern League owner line 715-409-1140 - verify.
Recently operating as Homestead on 52.

West-side tavern with outdoor volleyball, pool, darts, karaoke. Friday fry described as cod and perch baskets. Directory source only - confirm species, price, window. Not on any Lenten guide, a genuine gap.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Clark (Abbotsford straddles)). Friday haddock fry in multiple listings. Phone conflict (715-316-0040 vs 715-223-0000). Active Facebook page is the best photo source. Closed Mon/Tue.
Also written 'Just For 1'. Friday fry offers haddock, perch or shrimp. Dinners come with coleslaw, rye bread and choice of potato (homemade or German potato salad, baked, fries).
OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Perch and cod, choice of potatoes, fresh coleslaw; Fri-Sat 5-9PM. PHONE DELIBERATELY BLANK - the aggregator number matches Hugo's Pizza, almost certainly wrong.
Tripadvisor review headline: 'Quaint with Excellent Friday Fish Fry'. Homemade beer battered fish (species not stated, likely cod). Full-service bar. Closed Mondays.
Village of Athens official business directory names 'our Friday Fish Fry'. West side of the Village Square. Fish fry start time and species not published - call.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Bowling alley with a grill; Merrill Chamber lists it as 'Les & Jim's Center Grill' at the same address. Friday fish offered baked as well as fried. Already in WPR's Lenten guide.
Winner, 2026 reader poll. Friday menu posted on website.

VERIFY THE NAME. This address cycled names: Yelp has 'The Local Pub & Grill' at 311 Main St marked CLOSED (Nov 2025) and a separate 'Main Street Pub & Grill' updated Jan 2026 showing Thu-Sun 11AM-12AM. Friday fry: 1pc walleye, cod, 3pc shrimp.

Downtown pub with a 'Friday Fish Specials' menu section and a 'Poor Man's Slopster' for fish fry Fridays. Own site does not name the fry or species. Closed Mon-Tue. Hosts the separate Mumble Wrap concept in-house - ask which kitchen runs the fry.

Banquet hall seating up to 700 that opens to the public 4-8PM every Friday for fish fry, salad bar and old fashioned specials. Good for large groups. Yelp's '1485 County Road NN' is wrong; the fire number from their own site is correct.

Downtown cafe open 6AM-2PM six days but stays open Friday evening for the fish fry. Beer-batter fish, Poor Man's, shrimp basket, combo. Formerly S & S Cafe. Sources disagree on Friday close (7PM vs 8PM) and address (313 vs 400 Main St) - verify.
Own site advertises Friday fish fry $8.75 (1pc) / $13.75 (2pc) / $16.50 (3pc) with fries, wedges or curly fries. Species not named - call before setting the fish column.
Sister location to Nutz Deep II in Marshfield. Reviews single out Friday haddock and walleye. Listed hours are bar hours; kitchen hours for the fry not published - worth a call.
8th in the 2026 reader poll.

Village of Kronenwetter news page: 'World Famous' Friday fish fry draws ~400 customers weekly. Family-run in a renovated bank building. Also in WPR's Lenten guide under a Rothschild mailing address. Confirm exact Friday lineup and whether cod is offered. Closed Sundays.
Known for the Poor Man's fish fry.

OUTSIDE MARATHON COUNTY (Lincoln). Named best fish fry in the Northwoods by WAOW. Family-owned, OPEN FRIDAYS ONLY. Lightly battered haddock with coleslaw, buttered brown bread, choice of soup. CASH ONLY, ATM on site. Gets very busy. Rural fire-number address.
Historic building with a repurposed underground bowling alley - good photo/description hook for a paid listing. Weekly Friday fry, haddock dinners praised.
All-day breakfast plus bar. Reviews cite BAKED cod fish fry dinners Fridays - ask whether fried cod is also offered, since baked-only is unusual.
Tavern League member and the only bar/grill found in Fenwood. Fry starts 11AM Friday, choice of cod or walleye. Also breakfast, subs, pizza, burgers. Not the same as 'The Rail Trail Cafe' in Ogema.
3rd in the 2026 reader poll. Beer-battered haddock, fish tacos, and a Finnish-style baked haddock.
5th in the 2026 reader poll.

Rural tavern on County Rd S with an Edgar mailing address - physically in the Rib Falls/Berlin township area, so effectively the Rib Falls fish fry. Known for fish & chips; Wednesday fish wrap special.
